source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES reads a plausible resource but assumes FRU_CEMR identity, suppresses all except three fields, bypasses certificate validation and fails to perform the specified IPMI comparison.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED calls for actual right-module mapping, protected full Redfish/IPMI/UI parity and immutable raw evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 953/2291 treats the guessed URI as directly runnable and does not prevent evidence from the left CEM module or baseboard.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: CEML is the left module and CEMBB is the baseboard; their similar product fields must not satisfy this right-module record. CPUSLED following it is a different asset class.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: The invalidated histories contain no exact CEMR draft.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves the WebUI/IPMI method, ED-34 controls substitutions, ED-35 keeps complete right-module coverage and ED-36 leaves missing maps/reference as readiness.

original_test_intent: Confirm that FRU_CEMR represents the physical right CEM module and that its entire required inventory matches across the BMC WebUI, exact Redfish member, exact read-only IPMI FRU device and approved reference.
original_method: First establish right-slot identity and both management mappings; then preserve complete read-only Redfish and IPMI outputs, capture the WebUI detail, normalize field encodings and compare the board-specific matrix without clearing diagnostic logs or modifying FRU storage.
manual_activity: A platform owner binds the physical right module to Redfish and IPMI identities and supplies the accepted FRU matrix. The agent can acquire and compare data; operator/engineer review handles UI-only fields and source disagreements.
required_inputs: Right CEM location and board identity
safety_requirements: Preserve existing SEL and host logs; do not perform the generic clear step.
Limit commands to reads and prohibit FRU edit/write, BMC reset and host reboot.
Validate right-module linkage before accepting any data; reject CEML/CEMBB substitutions.
Use certificate-validated protected sessions and conceal serial/asset/custom manufacturing fields.
Keep raw evidence alongside decoded/trimmed representations.
If endpoint, IPMI target or authoritative source remains ambiguous, stop and escalate without automatic retries.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the right CEM physical identity and matching Redfish/IPMI objects.
Capture full redacted structured data and IPMI FRU output with target metadata/time.
Record the WebUI FRU_CEMR page and normalize the approved inventory fields.
Produce a four-way comparison against Project reference with explicit missing/stale/encoding results.
Do not state a hardware verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve field authority, normalization and confidentiality rules.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It is a partial candidate read only: the command assumes a right-module URI, weakens TLS and omits the mandatory IPMI and complete-field comparisons.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate CEMR from the Chassis collection, verify its right-slot links, read the mapped IPMI FRU and compare complete protected evidence with UI/reference.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_CEMR identity, Hardware status path, ipmitool cross-check, Criterion and original time estimates are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform right-slot-bound Redfish/IPMI/WebUI/reference FRU reconciliation with raw provenance.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Capture BMC, Redfish and FRU decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CEMR device map/FRU layout and Project manufacturing record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic side binding, complete fields and secure/redacted acquisition while preserving all original comparison surfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three projected API fields do not demonstrate right-slot, IPMI or full WebUI correctness.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Right-slot mapping, device IDs, FRU matrix and source rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mirrored modules may share values, and stale caches can conceal a left/right swap.

project_override_considerations: A different inventory decoder can be approved only when its exact CEMR target, per-field equivalence, reason/approval and any lost WebUI/IPMI coverage are documented.
expected_evidence: Right CEM physical identity plus verified Redfish/IPMI mapping
Complete timestamped raw redacted Redfish and IPMI records
WebUI capture and approved FRU reference
Encoding-aware field matrix with positive exclusion of CEML/CEMBB
Uncleared logs, no-state-change record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master consistently asks for CEMR inventory and IPMI parity. The deficiencies are confined to prior automation advice.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Right-module FRU validation is semantically clear; device maps and expected values are execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Expands beyond a guessed, insecure three-field read and restores IPMI/UI obligations.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Confirms its hybrid class and target-binding controls independently.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Prevents mirrored CEML and CEMBB evidence from cross-crediting this record.

review_improvement: Makes right-side physical binding and negative exclusion of the other CEM FRUs auditable before any field match is credited.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mirrored CEM modules frequently share manufacturer and product strings, so a three-field response can look correct even when it comes from the left side. Physical relationship links, IPMI device mapping and a unique identifier must all point to the right module before semantic field comparison has value.
